name: Resolved reference links
description: Counts Markdown reference-style links whose id has a matching definition — [text][id] paired with a [id]: url line. Orphan reference links (no definition) aren't counted. Demonstrates the "intersect" mode.
author: pan4ratte
label: Reference links
title: Reference links
hint: Counts reference-style links that have a matching [id]: definition
